steps: Assess human rights for health monitoring & evaluation using UN treaty body recommendations
Design NHRI per Paris Principles with independence and broad mandate
Implement monitoring with complaint mechanism and systemic investigation
Deploy reporting with treaty body and UPR submissions
Measure through recommendation implementation and rights outcome indicators
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — human rights compliance using treaty body reporting. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — human rights compliance measured biannually. Target: 90% recommendations implemented. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against UN UPR compliance benchmark. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — human rights compliance trending toward 95% implemented. Escalate if <75% implemented floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using UN UPR framework. Report to Human Rights Commissioner.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a prosecution and criminal procedure specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 14 days.
